meta.scoring_doctrine_applied: Greg S108: mean error is a dashboard number, never a diagnosis - fix off individual events. Every item below is justified by NAMED DATED events, and where a specialist claimed a mechanism I checked whether the MECHANISM was tested or only the NET. That check is what killed the timing limb below.

the_headline_retraction.what_G20_banked: A pre-print generator, merged as a scope extension, credited with 2,090 of D's G20 blind-vs-refine gap.
the_headline_retraction.what_G21_measured: D decomposed all FOUR prints the generator has produced, by leg (overnight / pre-print / print / PM):  0528 -170/+970/+1160/+140 | 0604 -70/+1010/+210/-20 | 0611 -690/-80/-240/-70 | 0618 -50/0/+760/-190.

verdict.SELECTION limb: SURVIVES 4/4. COT extreme AND worsening WoW -> up; improving -> stand down. Open-time. It split D's two G21 Thursdays correctly: declined 0611 (WoW +19,572 improving) and fired 0618 (WoW -7,763, 2.83 pctile, still adding).
verdict.TIMING limb: REFUTED, 1 of 4. The dominant leg lands in a different window on all four days. On 0618 - its own firing day - the 06:00-10:00 window delivered EXACTLY ZERO and onset was 11:06, thirty-six minutes AFTER the print. The mechanism is not pre-print de-risk; it is POST-RESOLUTION COVERING (an in-line 73-vs-75 print removed the adverse tail and the 2.83-pctile short covered; ph2 ran -961 sflow under +770 px = absorption).
verdict.MAGNITUDE limb: Oversized BECAUSE of the timing limb - believing the window was known produced a peak-shaped path closed at the peak. D's peak (+990) was within 110 of the realized peak (+880); the whole 430 error was the missing give-back.

the_headline_retraction.why_this_matters_more_than_the_number: G20 credited this generator FROM DAY NETS. The intraday check was never run. A right day-net carried a false mechanism into the brain, and the MECHANISM is what gets extrapolated to the next group. This is the exact failure the no-pooling rule exists to prevent, and it was caught only by decomposing individual events.
the_headline_retraction.action: Keep the SELECTION limb with its 4/4 record. STRIKE the timing claim. Record the post-resolution-covering reading as the candidate replacement at n=1, not as a merged mechanism.

value.the_dispute: D scoped the final-phase-conviction arm OUT of Friday->Monday, believing its single failure was the weekend seam. A measured all 9 G21 boundaries and located the failure at 0616->0617, INTRA-WEEK, with the weekend seam as the arm's largest clean hit (-750).
value.B_adjudication_and_the_new_measurement: D's scope conclusion is right and D's evidence for it is wrong; A's location correction is right and A's conclusion is wrong. 24 OF 24 intra-week boundaries across G19+G20+G21 carry |gap| <= 10 - identically zero by market structure - so D built a scope on eight vacuous cases and A banked one weekend hit off the same vacuity.

All four G20 exemplars carry NEGATIVE ph3 flow, so with flow sign held constant the two readings are observationally IDENTICAL on 4 of 4. Picking a winner would be picking on a confound.
value.the_scorable_evidence: On the four weekend seams the walk can score, BOTH readings go 2/4: 0518 (+580), 0601 (+690), 0605->0608 (-350, the one nobody ran), 0615 (-750). All four are ALIGNED; the ABSORBED branch has never met a seam.

value.g21_0608: B declined the chain_drift rung in the blind 'ON EVIDENCE', reasoning that the anchor closed off its low and not at a chain-side extreme. The anchor's close_off_low_frac was 0.08 - that IS the chain-side extreme. The rung fires, band -600..-1600, and the realized -890 sits in band.
value.root_cause_one_substitution: B's blind asserted the anchor's final phase was ABSORBED on the strength of last_hour_dir +1 - a 60-MINUTE object read as a phase verdict. 0605 ph3 actually ran -2,386 of sell under -590 of price, ph_absorb FALSE, low_late TRUE, turn_kind none. Four separate constructions rested on that one substitution.
value.why_recorded: The two fields that catch it - last_hour_dir and close_off_low_frac - sit side by side in the same block. This is a reading discipline failure, not a data failure, and it cost 470 on a clean day.

value.withdrawn_fire: C's G21 0616 fire is WITHDRAWN - its precondition rests on a session whose realized signed-flow sign is opposite to what was served (hole #8 contamination).

value.mirror_arm_still_refuted: E adds a FIFTH datapoint (0611: 0.572 under -3,772 flow -> +620). Above-0.50 readings under a negative tape now run two up, two down, no ordering. The mirror arm stays refuted and the play stays HALF-SCOPE.
value.the_open_slot: C's verdict on the blind's residual is that it is TIMIDITY, not bias - the blind emitted 24% of the available move (mean |blind| 148 against mean |actual| 625 on its days). Removing the structural down-gate did not install an up-gate; it removed what was manufacturing conviction. What is left is a blind that sees the flow but not whether it will be ABSORBED - and on this block absorb_session x sflow_sign calls the day sign 9 of 10. This play is the only instrument in that slot and it covers positive-flow only.

new_plays_proposed.one_line: On a scheduled-program day, a same-signed aggressor tilt is SUSPECT, not confirmation - a resting program is filled by the crowd, so it prints the opposite aggressor sign to its own direction.
new_plays_proposed.trigger: flow_calendar in_bcom_roll or in_gsci_roll TRUE (deterministic, never masked, open-time).
new_plays_proposed.measured: G21 0608 printed +3,261 of net aggressor BUY while falling -890, absorb_session TRUE, ph2 +2,858 of buy against -120 of price. The index program rested offers and the crowd hit them.
new_plays_proposed.generalises_a_known_case: A named the same inversion for a covering short (it RESTS BIDS and prints negative aggressor flow under rising price). B's finding is that this is a property of ANY resting program, not of covering specifically - which is why A's COT-residual meter was sign-inverted.
new_plays_proposed.blind_available: YES - the roll calendar is deterministic and never masked.
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: A scheduled-program session where the aggressor tilt matches the day sign and the program is demonstrably the dominant participant.
